Macrons

Consonantal i

Consonantal u

Theme

Work & responsibility · Money, work & business

management noun

the running of a business or of affairs

also managing, administration, stewardship, running a business

classical

Cic. N.D. 1.2: cūrātiōne et administrātiōne rērum (Lewis & Short)
Cic. Off. 1.92: eārum administrātiō
Traupman 178
Traupman 269

administrātiō, administrātiōnis f.

noun, third declension

management, direction

The managing of anything, a household or the state; Traupman’s administrāre is to manage on a large scale (p. 343).

Other words

  • dispēnsātiō, dispēnsātiōnis f. — the management of money; stewardship

    noun, third declension · also used · classical · Cic. Att. 15.15.3: Erōtis dispēnsātiō

    The work of the dispēnsātor, the steward who kept the accounts.

Examples

  • profectiōnem meam, ut videō, Erōtis dispēnsātiō impedit

    my departure, as I see, is held up by Eros’ management of my moneyCic. Att. 15.15.3

See also manager, in charge, director.

SourcesLewis & Short: administratio · Lewis & Short: dispensatio

John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 343.
